host_selection.rule: host-bound cells (eager, cuda_graph option, decoding) use the rounds of the host-bound lanes (one per CPU socket) whose cells all spread by at most 10% over that lane's rounds; graph-only cells use every round
host_selection.rule_uncontended: no host-bound lane met the 10% rule: per host-bound cell, version and timed metric, the median over both lanes' processes within 1.15x of the cell's fastest process (at least 3)

changes: model with the frozen selections, bf16: the fixed bf16 ceilings are replaced by the noise-referenced test (graph vs eager <= CG_NOISE_MULT x the largest eager-vs-eager deviation per tensor, the fixed ceiling as the floor)
per-head tensors of at most 16 elements (A_log, dt_bias, a_proj/b_proj bias), every model check: judged together per step, one relative RMS over their concatenation, with the noise-referenced test
unchanged: layer checks and the model with the frozen selections in fp32: fixed ceilings, every tensor
model with its own selections: noise-referenced test of every larger tensor
rationale: the fixed bf16 ceilings were designed for the op and the layer against float64, not for 24 layers of bf16 accumulation
a relative maximum over a 2-element tensor, with 8 eager-vs-eager samples against 4 graph samples, is heavy-tailed
